newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-NZ-SRI LANKA MATCH ABANDONED DUE TO RAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NZ-SRI LANKA MATCH ABANDONED DUE TO RAIN.

text.p: Rain has forced the abandonment of Sunday's one-day international between Sri Lanka and New Zealand at Auckland's Eden Park.
The match, the first in a three-game series, was originally scheduled for Saturday but was postponed because of heavy rain.
The start time was again delayed on Sunday morning due to rain. At 2.15 p.m. (0215 GMT) the umpires announced the game was abandoned.
The next match is a day/nighter in Christchurch on Tuesday.
